title: Claude Code Plan Mode: The One Workflow Change That Prevents 90% of Mistakes
summary: Claude Code's plan mode makes Claude read and plan before touching a file. Learn how to enable it, when to use it, and how to build a spec-driven workflow that catches mistakes before they happen.
body_markdown: Asking "what would you do?" in default mode is advisory — Claude might start editing while explaining its intent. Plan mode is a hard permission constraint. Claude cannot edit files until you approve the plan. The enforcement is in the tool, not in Claude's judgment.
